stories.title: Sky's stablecoin loses more than $2 billion in a single day
stories.summary: CryptoSlate reports that more than $2 billion exited Sky's stablecoin in one day. The report does not state a cause for the rapid outflow. The scale of the move is large enough to raise questions about the token's stability.
stories.whyItMatters: Stablecoins anchor most crypto trading and DeFi activity, so a fast, large outflow can signal stress that spreads to other markets.
whatToWatch: Whether the stablecoin's peg holds in the days ahead
Any statement from Sky on the cause of the outflow
Whether other stablecoins see similar redemptions
questions: Did the stablecoin's price move off its peg?

stories.title: Chainflip founder confirms heavy losses after second hack in 10 weeks drains $12 million
stories.summary: Chainflip's founder acknowledged significant losses after a hack drained $12 million from the protocol, CryptoSlate reports. This is the second hack in 10 weeks. Repeated breaches raise concerns about the protocol's security.
stories.whyItMatters: Repeat hacks at the same protocol erode user trust and raise sector-wide questions about audit quality in cross-chain infrastructure.
whatToWatch: Whether Chainflip publishes a post-mortem on the breach
Any compensation plan for affected users
Changes to the protocol's security practices
questions: What vulnerability let attackers strike twice in 10 weeks?
Will the drained funds be recovered or frozen?

stories.title: Robinhood Chain pays Ethereum 70% more than Base, despite collecting 64% less in fees
stories.summary: Robinhood Chain pays more to Ethereum than Base pays for settlement, even though Base collects far more in fees, per CryptoSlate. The gap points to a mismatch between what Robinhood's chain spends and what it earns. The report frames this as a cost-efficiency concern for the new chain.
stories.whyItMatters: Layer-2 cost structures affect trading fees and determine which chains stay profitable over time.
whatToWatch: Whether Robinhood adjusts its settlement costs or fee structure
How Robinhood Chain's economics compare with Base going forward
questions: Why does Robinhood Chain pay Ethereum so much more for so much less fee revenue?

stories.title: Bitcoin surges toward $64,000, then pulls back, as trading slows into Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Bitcoin pushed toward $64,000 before giving back some gains, CryptoSlate reports. Trading activity slowed by 54% heading into the Thanksgiving holiday, a typical pattern of thin liquidity. Thin markets can exaggerate price swings in either direction.
stories.whyItMatters: Holiday-driven liquidity drops make price moves less reliable as signals of real demand, worth weighing against any headline swing.
whatToWatch: Whether trading volume recovers after the Thanksgiving holiday
Whether the pullback extends or Bitcoin retests $64,000
questions: How much of the move reflects real demand versus thin holiday liquidity?

stories.title: Strategy raises buyback ceiling to $4 billion as MSTR shares sink 21%
stories.summary: Strategy raised its stock buyback ceiling to $4 billion, CryptoSlate reports. The move comes as MSTR shares sank 21%. Strategy holds a large Bitcoin treasury, so its stock price tracks Bitcoin sentiment closely.
stories.whyItMatters: Strategy's stock is a widely watched proxy for Bitcoin, so a large buyback alongside a steep share drop signals how investors see corporate Bitcoin bets right now.
whatToWatch: Whether Strategy executes buybacks under the new ceiling
Whether MSTR shares stabilize or fall further
Any update on Strategy's Bitcoin holdings
questions: Will the buyback meaningfully support the stock price?

stories.title: Monad faces $190 million insider token unlock bigger than its market cap as MON hits record low
stories.summary: Monad is set to unlock $190 million worth of insider tokens, an amount larger than the token's entire market cap, CryptoSlate reports. MON has fallen to a record low. The mismatch raises concern about selling pressure once the tokens unlock.
stories.whyItMatters: Large insider unlocks relative to market size can flood supply and crush price, a recurring risk for newer token launches.
whatToWatch: The unlock date and how much supply actually sells
Whether MON finds a new price floor after the unlock
Any statement from the Monad team on vesting adjustments
questions: Will insiders actually sell at unlock, or hold?
Can demand absorb $190 million in new supply against a smaller market cap?

stories.title: Bitcoin options hedges may expire an hour before ETF trading resumes on Black Friday
stories.summary: A timing gap means some Bitcoin hedges could expire about an hour before ETF trading reopens on Black Friday, CryptoSlate reports. The gap stems from the shortened holiday trading schedule. Traders relying on those hedges could be exposed during the window.
stories.whyItMatters: A hedging gap around a low-liquidity holiday session can amplify price swings for anyone caught unprotected.
whatToWatch: How markets behave in the gap window before ETF trading resumes
Whether traders adjust positions ahead of the shortened Black Friday session
questions: How many traders are actually exposed to this timing gap?

Further market reaction to the Nvidia leadership news
